versions.content: Large Data Path IF TxConfirmation Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_00061 When Com_TxConfirmation is invoked for an I-PDU with ComIPduLargeData set to true, AUTOSAR COM module shall use the passed I-PDU ID as Handle Id ( ComIPduHandleId ) to derive the corresponding <ComUser_ComCbkTxConfirma- tion> user notification callback and call it with the according Com user callback handle Id.
